description: This file defines a Roslyn analyzer for C# code that detects duplicate attribute IDs in classes, structs, and record types marked with a specific attribute. It reports diagnostics if duplicate IDs are found among members.

classes.name: IdClashAttributeAnalyzer
classes.description: A Roslyn diagnostic analyzer that checks for duplicate attribute IDs in class, struct, and record declarations.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the analysis context, enabling concurrent execution, configuring analysis of generated code, and registering syntax node actions for relevant declaration types.

methods.name: CheckSyntaxNode
methods.description: Analyzes a syntax node representing a type declaration to find duplicate attribute IDs and reports diagnostics if duplicates are detected.
